- Add step i using softprops/action-gh-release@v2 to publish signed APK as Release asset
- Guard with if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/') so manual workflow_dispatch only builds
- Grant job-level permissions: contents: write for Release creation
- Remove stale nested android/.github workflow copy
